description: A script that regenerates a certificate from a PEM file by applying substitutions, converting ASCII DER to binary, and updating the PEM file.

methods.name: read_file_to_string
methods.description: Reads a file entirely into a string.

methods.name: write_string_to_file
methods.description: Writes a string to a specified file.

methods.name: replace_string
methods.description: Replaces a specified range in a string with a replacement string.

methods.name: apply_substitution
methods.description: Finds a section in a template and replaces it with a given value.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that processes the PEM file, applies substitutions, converts ASCII DER to binary, and updates the PEM file.
